title: Mabel met with me near...
text: Mabel met with me near the cathedral for our photoshoot. She was friendly, informative, and helped me with poses throughout our time together. Mabel was receptive to my ideas of shots I wanted to take around the fountain and they came out perfectly. It was hard to choose just 10 photos to have edited because so many of the photos came out spectacularly. Turnaround time was quick from start to finish and I am happy to have beautiful memories captured in the Gothic Quarter that I will cherish forever.
author: Renee_B

title: I had such a wonderful...
text:
I had such a wonderful experience with this photoshoot tour! She was incredibly warm and welcoming from the start, which made me feel comfortable right away. Throughout the session, she was very communicative and made sure everything flowed smoothly.
Overall, it was a fun, relaxed, and memorable experience. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone looking for stunning photos and a genuinely enjoyable time!

title: Initially hooked for the...
text: Initially booked for the afternoon shoot as I had a tour booked in the morning. Mabel, the photographer, messaged me a day prior suggesting to do an early morning shoot for the soft winter sun glow and less crowd as it was a Friday. Sure glad I followed through with the suggestion, not only she was a delight to work with, but the photos turned out perfect!
